description: Browse, edit, and save the files an agent is working on without leaving BB. A file tree with new file, rename, upload, and delete sits beside the thread, and search in files reads every file in the workspace and opens a hit at its line. The CodeMirror editor saves with compare-and-swap, so a change the agent made while you were typing stops the save instead of overwriting it. An @ mention attaches a file whose contents are resolved at send time, and markdown renders Mermaid diagrams. A workspace on another machine works the same way.
